daily.title: New 'blanket' Safe Work rules not practical, say miners and farmers
daily.summary: Safe Work Australia's new rules for farms and mines using airborne contaminants are due to take effect on December 1, but industry says there has been little consultation and the rules are not practical.

daily.title: Man dies after being towed by quad bike in regional NSW

daily.title: Mother confirmed a suspect in alleged domestic violence stabbings

daily.title: She went missing after leaving the ANU Bar in 1980. The mystery remains
